# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/dnr/jq-ro.sh. test-jq-ro.sh runs each one in its fixture working
# directory, a git repository whose config names a program, which holds: the run directories incident_1
# (data.json, corpus/transactions.jsonl) and audit_1 (data.json); notes/t.json and data.json outside
# every run directory; incident_2, a symbolic link to incident_1; incident_3, a run directory holding a
# symbolic link (link.json) beside data.json; incident_4, with no .gitignore; incident_5, tracked by git;
# incident_7/hard.json, a second link to a file outside the working directory; incident_8/fifo, a named
# pipe; incident_10/sub, a symbolic link to a directory outside the working directory; and
# INCIDENT_9/data.json and incident_1234567/data.json, under names that are not run directories.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout, changes nothing in the working directory and starts no program the
# repository's config names.
# usage
